 This application coming on for admission this day, the 
 following:
 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.131/2023, registered at Police Station-Surkhi Sagar, District-Raisen (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 366, 366-A , 376 and 376(2)(n) of Indian Penal Code.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that prosecutrix is aged about 16 years.
It is submitted that applicant is innocent.

In these circumstances,
applicant may be released on bail.
3 . Learned Deputy Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail.

sentences.text: 4. Heard the counsel for the parties.

5. Prosecutrix is aged about 16 years and have sufficient maturity and understanding.
6. Considering aforesaid facts and circumstances, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

It is directed that applicant be released on bail on furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
7. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.
